scenarios.prompt: Research the strongest next video for my beginner woodworking channel, then give me titles and a thumbnail concept.
expectations: Clarifies the target viewer, objective, format, geography, and timeframe before drawing conclusions.
Uses public YouTube and current web evidence to recommend a differentiated concept, title options, outline, and complementary thumbnail brief.

scenarios.prompt: Watch the top five videos about AI agents, quote the best moments from their transcripts, and repurpose them into my script.
expectations: States that the available YouTube tool cannot watch videos or retrieve transcripts and asks the user to supply transcript text for that portion.
Does not invent spoken content, quotes, private analytics, or transcript-based findings.

scenarios.prompt: Make the finished thumbnail for the video strategy we chose. Use the headline STOP WASTING PROMPTS and my attached portrait.
expectations: Uses the confirmed video promise, requested overlay copy, and attached portrait in a production-ready Thumbnail Director brief.

After a 1280x720 PNG is returned, visually checks the requested wording and unexpected text, makes at most one simplified retry when needed, and labels an unverified or still-flawed result as a draft with the specific limitation.
